history_summary: Add the Nitrososphaera viennensis species-reference GTDB correspondence
history_details: Preserve EN76 and RS2 identities, the existing Sphingobium genus-level block and all experimental contexts. Native Nitrososphaera species-ID correspondence has three archaeal reference genomes/fraction 1.0; it does not establish exact EN76 assembly membership. Only taxonomy[1]'s GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. Abstract-only cultivation limitations, pot endpoints and modeled associations remain unchanged; no flux, mediation or new mechanism is inferred. Scoped database and provenance correction, not full scientific approval or corpus QC.
